title: Welcome to PichiPlayer v1.0.0! 🚀
message: Initial official release of PichiPlayer - The ultra-fast, modern, offline video player for Android with 4K/2K smooth playback, Auto/HW/SW decoder engine, and complete format support.
changelog: 🎬 Complete Resolution Badges: Full detection for 240p, 360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p (FHD), 2K, 4K, 8K & 3GP format tags.
⚡ Auto / HW / SW Decoder Engine: Choose between Smart Auto, GPU Hardware MediaCodec, or Software CPU decoding directly from Settings or the Player HUD.
🚀 2K & 4K Ultra-Smooth Playback: Asynchronous hardware buffer queueing, 64MB high-bitrate load control, and zero-stutter playback.
✨ Micro-Animations: Spring-damped rotation swivel, play/pause bounce pulse, and fluid overlay transitions.
🎛️ Streamlined Home Card Player: 10s seek buttons, play/pause, and dismissable preview card showing last-played video details.
📱 Ergonomic Top Bar: Subtitles and PiP buttons conveniently placed next to screen rotation.
🔄 Update Manager & What's New: Auto-update checker and first-launch release notes modal.
